compiled_state.title: Create design-md-lint.sh wrapper with three-state config gate and diff scoping
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: design-md-lint.sh exists at plugins/dso/scripts/design-md-lint.sh with executable bit set, wraps npx --yes @google/design.md@<pinned-version> lint, and scopes to diff-touched lines of scope-eligible files
- dd-2: The three-state config gate design.lint_enabled (auto|always|never) is implemented; auto resolves to enabled when a UI stack is detected
- dd-4: Pre-existing violations in lines not touched by the current diff are not blocked

## Implementation
Create plugins/dso/scripts/design-md-lint.sh as a bash script that:
1. Reads design.lint_enabled from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh (accepts auto|always|never; defaults to auto)
2. In auto mode, runs detect-ui-files.sh against staged files to decide enablement
3. When never or auto-without-UI-files, exits 0 immediately
4. Uses git diff --cached --unified=0 to extract diff-touched line ranges per file
5. Invokes npx --yes @google/design.md@<pinned-version> lint scoped only to those lines
6. Exits non-zero only when violations appear in diff-touched lines
7. Handles: missing npx (command -v short-circuit exit 0), no staged files (exit 0), missing DESIGN.md (exit 0)

chmod +x the script immediately after creation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Script file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/design-md-lint.sh
- [ ] Script exits 0 (no-op) when design.lint_enabled=never
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-design-md-lint.sh
- [ ] Script in auto mode enables lint when UI files staged
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-design-md-lint.sh
- [ ] Script scopes to diff-touched lines only; untouched violations do not cause non-zero exit
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-design-md-lint.sh
- [ ] Script exits 0 when npx is absent (command -v short-circuit)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-design-md-lint.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_design_md_lint_diff_scoping] for plugins/dso/scripts/design-md-lint.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_design_md_lint_diff_scoping\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
